# AI Phone Debloater

> AI Phone Debloater is a free, open-source (MIT) tool by Rovoxia that removes preinstalled Android apps over ADB without root. It checks every package against 352 curated rules, refuses to touch 89 critical system packages, and saves a restore snapshot before each change.

It has two front ends that share one rule set: a Python 3.11+ CLI (standard library only, no pip install) and a web app at /app that reaches the phone over WebUSB (Chromium browsers) or a local ADB bridge on 127.0.0.1:53123 that needs a per-session token. The rules are 196 Tier 1 (Safe), 66 Tier 2 (Advanced), 1 Tier 3 (Extreme: the Transsion OTA updater, whose removal stops system updates) and 89 Tier 4 (Critical, blocked), covering Samsung, Xiaomi, Google Pixel, OnePlus, Oppo, Vivo, Realme, Motorola, Huawei, Transsion (Tecno, Infinix, itel) and apps found on many brands. Changes are made with `pm disable-user` and `pm uninstall -k` for one Android user and can be undone; the system partition is not modified. Dry run is a CLI flag (`--dry-run`); the web app has no dry run and asks for confirmation before every change. Run it with `irm https://debloater.rovoxia.com/run.ps1 | iex` (Windows) or `curl -fsSL https://debloater.rovoxia.com/run.sh | bash` (macOS, Linux).

## Docs

- [Full technical reference](https://debloater.rovoxia.com/llms-full.txt): tiers, the critical list, per-brand rules, CLI flags, bridge security, rollback and FAQ answers
- [Master AI prompt](https://debloater.rovoxia.com/prompt.md): instructions an AI coding agent follows to scan, dry-run, apply and undo a debloat with the user's approval
- [Pricing](https://debloater.rovoxia.com/pricing.md): free and open source under MIT, no paid edition

## Pages

- [Home](https://debloater.rovoxia.com): what the tool does, the safety tiers, the one-line installers and the FAQ
- [Web app](https://debloater.rovoxia.com/app): debloat from the browser over WebUSB or the local bridge; every change is confirmed first
- [OEM rule list](https://debloater.rovoxia.com/oems): searchable list of all 352 package rules with brand, tier and action
- [Blog](https://debloater.rovoxia.com/blog): debloat guides by phone brand, plus ADB setup and safety tiers
- [How to debloat a Samsung Galaxy phone without root](https://debloater.rovoxia.com/blog/samsung-galaxy-debloat-guide-one-ui-6)

- [How to debloat a Google Pixel without root](https://debloater.rovoxia.com/blog/pixel-debloat-guide-stock-android)
- [How to debloat OnePlus, Oppo and Realme phones without root](https://debloater.rovoxia.com/blog/oneplus-oppo-realme-debloat-guide-coloros)

- [How to debloat Tecno, Infinix and itel phones without root](https://debloater.rovoxia.com/blog/transsion-debloat-guide-hios-xos)
- [Debloat or factory reset: which one should you use?](https://debloater.rovoxia.com/blog/debloat-vs-factory-reset): what each one changes on the phone
- [ADB debloat safety tiers: what do Tier 1 to Tier 4 mean?](https://debloater.rovoxia.com/blog/adb-debloat-safety-tiers-explained): how a package gets its tier and how Tier 4 is enforced
- [How to set up wireless ADB for debloating (Android 11+)](https://debloater.rovoxia.com/blog/wireless-adb-debloat-setup-android-11): pairing without a cable

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Rovoxia/AI-Phone-Debloater): CLI, local bridge, rule files and website source (MIT)
- [Releases](https://github.com/Rovoxia/AI-Phone-Debloater/releases): tagged versions and release notes
- [Rule files](https://github.com/Rovoxia/AI-Phone-Debloater/tree/main/cli/rules): the JSON rule set both front ends use
- [Security policy](https://github.com/Rovoxia/AI-Phone-Debloater/blob/main/SECURITY.md): bridge gate, token and how to report a vulnerability

## Optional

- [Windows installer script](https://debloater.rovoxia.com/run.ps1): downloads the CLI into `~/.ai-phone-debloater` and starts it
- [macOS and Linux installer script](https://debloater.rovoxia.com/run.sh): the same for Bash
- [Windows bridge script](https://debloater.rovoxia.com/bridge.ps1): starts the local bridge with a fresh token and opens the web app
- [macOS and Linux bridge script](https://debloater.rovoxia.com/bridge.sh): the same for Bash
- [Rovoxia](https://rovoxia.com): the organization that maintains the project
